messages.subject: RE: Project Drake — SPA mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (redline against your first draft). The headline pushes from our side: warranty cap down to 25% (£5.6m); general claims limit down to 18 months; de minimis up to £35k and basket up to £280k. We've left the environmental indemnity broadly as drafted but want to discuss the £250k cap. The earn-out and tax covenant are largely agreed.

Oliver

messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Thanks. 25% is too low for a founder sale of this size; we'll come back at a compromise. 18 months is acceptable in principle if we can hold the tax covenant at seven years. De minimis we can live with at £30k. Will revert with a buyer's draft shortly.

James
